    static boolean matches(String s, String test) {
        int xDigit = -1;

            char sc = s.charAt(j);

                    xDigit = tc;
                } else if (tc != xDigit) {
                    return false;
                }
            } else if (sc != '_' && sc != tc) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

        String s = sc.next();

        // Determine the range of numbers with length L
        int start = (L == 1) ? 0 : (int) Math.pow(10, L - 1);
        int end = (int) Math.pow(10, L) - 1;
        int count = 0;
        int firstMultiple = (start % 25 == 0) ? start : start + (25 - start % 25);
        for (int i = firstMultiple; i <= end; i += 25) {
            if (i >= 100000000) break;
            String test = Integer.toString(i);

            char[] pattern = s.toCharArray();
            char[] digits = test.toCharArray();
